summary.description: A high level walkthrough of the steps, used to provide an idea of what is involved in making the recipe. It should be a maximum of 3 sentences. For example: 'This recipe involves chopping vegetables with a knife, cooking pasta in a pot, and making a tomato-based sauce in a skillet. The pasta is combined with the sauce along with some of the pasta water and the dish should be served immediately.

ingredients.description: List of ingredients. Each entry is an object with separate name, amount, and modifier properties.

name.description: The grocery/shopping name only, without quantity or preparation adjectives. Prefer the common grocery name, typically singular (e.g. 'chicken breast', 'yellow onion', 'all-purpose flour', 'garlic clove').

anyOf.description: A numeric quantity when the amount is a plain number (e.g. 2 for 2 yellow onions, 3 for 3 garlic cloves).
A string quantity when units or non-numeric wording are needed (e.g. '1 lb', '2 cups', '1 stick', '1/2 tsp', 'to taste').

amount.description: The quantity. Prefer a number when possible (e.g. 2). Use a string when units or non-numeric wording are needed (e.g. '1 lb', '1 stick', '2 cups', 'to taste').

modifier.description: Preparation adjectives or descriptors that are not part of the grocery name (e.g. 'thinly sliced', 'minced', 'chopped', 'softened'). Empty string if there is no modifier.

items.description: Pans, pots, utensils, and anything else needed for the recipe
An individual step within the recipe
